title: Improving Spinal Cord Stimulation With ECAPS
official: Improving Spinal Cord Stimulation With ECAPS
summary: The purpose of this study will be to investigate the optimization of spinal cord stimulation with ECAPs in patients with spinal cord implants.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Medically stable as determined by the principal investigator
* Scheduled to undergo externalization of spinal cord stimulation
* English-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Scheduled for permanent implantation only without trial
* Have pacemakers or other neurostimulators
* Pregnancy
